title: NIST WebBook: potassium nitrate is KNO3, molecular weight 101.1032 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists potassium nitrate as KNO3, molecular weight 101.1032 amu, CAS 7757-79-1.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for potassium nitrate, CAS Registry Number 7757-79-1, lists molecular formula KNO3 and molecular weight 101.1032 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 100.95152454 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/K.NO3/c;2-1(3)4/q+1;-1. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
